newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FREE STATE 246-4 AT TEA AGAINST NORTHERNS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FREE STATE 246-4 AT TEA AGAINST NORTHERNS.

text.p: Free State were 246 for four in their first innings at tea on the opening day of their four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Northern Transvaal at Centurion Park on Friday.
Free State 246-4 in 69 overs (Gerhardus Liebenberg 49, Louis Wilkinson 87, Kosie Venter 59 not out; Rudi Bryson 2-37, Pierre Joubert 2-43).
